recorded-by: Claude Code agent session on Bare Cedar Fog (claude-opus-5-5)
request: Leader, 2026-10-25: set up npm orgs for red cup et al, so on-chain work can be split into packages the compute swarm works on and installs cheaply.

observations.fact: Every house scope in the workspace .npmrc routes to https://registry.561.group/, the Verdaccio on Bare Cedar Fog behind the bare-cedar-fog-561-group Cloudflare tunnel.
External CI installs against registry.561.group failed with HTTP 503/504 on 2026-10-24.

registry.npmjs.org /-/org/red-cup-engineering/package answered {"error":"Scope not found"}; the calibration /-/org/babel/package answered 200. The other twelve scopes were not read because Cloudflare rate-limited the registry (error 1015).
npm has no CLI or registry API that creates an organization; npm org only manages membership. Creation happens in the npmjs.com web UI by a signed-in user.
The npmjs search for maintainer:emsenn and maintainer:561-group returned 0 packages, and this host has no npmjs.com login.

risk: Dependency confusion: a machine without the house .npmrc resolves the house scopes from public npm, where anyone can register them.

decision.claim: Create a free npmjs organization (unlimited public packages, no card) for every house scope.
decision.user-scope: emsenn is a user scope: it is the npmjs username, if it is free.
decision.private-packages: Packages built from private repositories stay on registry.561.group. Free organizations hold public packages only, and cash is zero.
decision.public-packages: Packages from public repositories also publish to npmjs, with provenance, carrying the same bytes as their registry.561.group release, under the existing Operations authorization in scripts/publish-authorized-npm-package.mjs.
decision.routing: The .npmrc routing for a scope changes only once everything that scope needs is on npmjs.

human-step.why-human: An npmjs.com account and its sign-in are held by a person; agents do not create accounts or enter passwords.

next-agent-steps: Create the organizations through Claude in Chrome once it is connected and signed in to npmjs.com, or confirm that the Leader created them.
Store a granular access token, limited to the organizations with read-write packages, as npmjs.publish-token in the credential store.
Add an npmjs target to publish-authorized-npm-package.mjs, admitted only for public-repository packages.

After each name's first publish, move it to npm trusted publishing and retire the token for it. First verify npm's current runner support against the rule github-actions-use-held-runners-without-billing.
Verify by installing a public @red-cup-engineering package on a machine with no house .npmrc.
